title: poa pratensis f. humilis
intro: Poa pratensis f. humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Meadow Grass, is a low-growing perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Poa pratensis f. humilis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
